title: NANPA authority for shard-A NPAs 681, 684, 702 and 708

data.notes: Current NANPA material identifies 681 as West Virginia, 684 as American Samoa, 702 as Nevada (702/725 overlay), and 708 as Illinois (464/708 overlay). Each is an in-service U.S. or U.S.-territory geographic NANP code and satisfies shard-A rule integer(NPA) mod 3 == 0.
